verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs state that Financial Connections gives access to account owners' names and mailing addresses. Ownership details are positioned for fraud mitigation and verifying account ownership, and a dedicated ownership-refresh webhook supports keeping that data current. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of contact data (email/phone) on file at the bank, documented match/comparison guidance against your own customer records, and independent hands-on corroboration of the ownership data.
